notes: Curated eval for field-usable seller updates. Routing keeps channel updates off full launch kits. Output checks require channel-ready copy, not a launch plan. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please convert product or engineering release notes into concise field updates with customer impact, positioning implications, and action guidance.
Please summarize releases for sales, update talk tracks after product changes, or create enablement-ready release briefs.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable release notes to seller updates and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please build cross-functional launch readiness plans and field-ready launch assets for revenue teams.
Please package a defined or approved narrative into a concise one-pager, an assertion-led slide outline, or both from supplied source material.
Please build partner-ready enablement packages with separated external and internal operator assets, permitted-motion guidance, governed claims, and package-level readiness criteria.
Build the full launch kit for this release: training plan, go/no-go gates, owner matrix, and a post-launch adoption review.

output_structure_checks.name: release-notes-to-seller-updates-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Produces a change register with status, date or unknown, seller action, owner, and source.

output_structure_checks.name: release-notes-to-seller-updates-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: States who the update is for, customer impact, what to say, and what not to say.

output_structure_checks.name: release-notes-to-seller-updates-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Channel variants are rewrites for the requested channel, not a launch plan with training, gates, or an owner matrix.

output_structure_checks.name: release-notes-to-seller-updates-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Puts the usable requested channel message first, groups related changes when helpful, and keeps detailed source notes separate.
